references.text: Prohibition against eating meat torn by wild animals - the flesh must be thrown to the dogs
Whoever eats of an animal that died naturally shall wash their clothes and remain unclean until evening
Priests must not eat carrion or flesh torn by beasts so as not to become unclean
Prohibition against eating animals that died naturally - they may be given to foreigners or sold
Ezekiel protests against eating unclean food, including carrion and flesh torn by beasts
The priests must not eat anything from birds or animals that died naturally or were torn apart
The Apostolic Council's decision that Gentile Christians should abstain from what has been strangled
The letter to Gentile Christians with the command to abstain from what has been strangled
